name: futures-trading-harness
description: Futures trading harness for Claude Code on TopstepX: parallel analyst, risk, executor, and reviewer agents, strategy playbook skills, and fail-closed order-gate hooks for the projectx-mcp server.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable trading harness hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run the order gate, session briefing, and review reminder. Turning this off removes the harness discipline layer; the projectx-mcp server guardrails still apply.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: minimal, standard, or strict. The order gate and briefing run in every profile; the review reminder runs in standard and strict.
